citations.assessment: The corresponding dedicated heading spells the patronymic out; the roster does not itself identify an individual named Kahana as progenitor of every name listed.
Temurah explicitly attests this name as the addressee of a question from Avin bar Ḥiyya.
Heilprin’s Bivi entry explicitly directs to Avin bar Kahana. Preserve the “or” as his own uncertainty.
The exact patronymic occurs in Shabbat and the corresponding Heilprin entry.
The name occurs explicitly in the wine-of-terumah account which the dedicated entry quotes. This corroborates the spelling and does not resolve the preceding Shemuel notice.

evidence.witness: The Tosefta according to to codex Vienna. Third Augmented Edition, JTS 2001

holds.reason: The dedicated entry repeats the nonfinding and suggests Shimon only conjecturally. Preserve this spelling and the nonfinding.
